description: This file contains PHPUnit test cases for the Audit module in SuiteCRM. It tests creation of Audit objects, their attributes, and some methods like get_summary_text, get_audit_list, and getAssociatedFieldName.

classes.name: AuditTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class for testing the Audit module functionalities in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test environment, creates a dummy current user.

methods.name: testAudit
methods.description: Tests creation of an Audit bean and its basic attributes.

methods.name: testget_summary_text
methods.description: Verifies the get_summary_text method returns correct value before and after setting the name.

methods.name: testget_audit_list
methods.description: Checks that get_audit_list returns an array for the Audit module.

methods.name: testgetAssociatedFieldName
methods.description: Tests getAssociatedFieldName method for different field types.
